evals.name: output-kind-ignores-directory-names
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-containers

The convention home resolves and the authoring-formats doc declares diagram_dialect.system: c4-plantuml. The repository has a Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web project in a directory named Worker, a Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Worker project in a directory named Api, an OutputType Exe in a directory named Web, and a class library in a directory named Services. No dependency-graph.json exists.
evals.expected_output: Runs collect-containers.sh and render-containers.sh. The web SDK is kind web, the worker SDK is kind worker, the exe is kind cli, and the class library is not a container. Renders containers.md with one fenced plantuml block (C4_Container).
expectations: Does not classify a project from its directory name
Resolves diagram_dialect.system to c4-plantuml, passes --dialect c4-plantuml, and does not read landscape_dialect
Omits --graph because dependency-graph.json is absent, and the record says containment is project-references
Closes with the fixed report: artifacts, focal, deployables, stores, modules, shared, excluded, working tree, dialect, technology, containment source, thin result, redaction

evals.name: modular-monolith-is-one-container
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-containers

The convention home resolves. One web SDK project references a class library, and that library references a second class library. The library source contains WebApplication.CreateBuilder and a string that looks like a secret.
evals.expected_output: One deployable. Both libraries are contained modules. The diagram draws one Container. The secret string is absent. The host-builder call inside the library does not create a second deployable.
expectations: Renders one container whose summary names both modules
Does not copy source text into the record
Does not draw the libraries as containers

evals.name: shared-broker-cites-both-keys-and-redacts
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-containers

Two deployables each set Messaging.Broker to sb://orders.servicebus.windows.net/. One connection string contains a password and an account key. An untracked appsettings file names a different host.
evals.expected_output: One shared-infrastructure edge whose evidence cites both config keys. The password, account key, and untracked host are absent. The database host remains. Every node has a technology field.
expectations: Uses redact-connection and does not store the raw config value
Does not read the untracked file
Does not treat co-location in the repository as an edge by itself

evals.name: endpoint-edge-needs-resolving-fact
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-containers

A docker-compose.yml defines a service named catalog whose build context is the Catalog web project directory. The Web project's appsettings.json sets Services.Catalog.Url to http://catalog:8080, and a Reports project sets Services.Billing.Url to https://billing.example.com. No project directory is named Billing.
evals.expected_output: One uses edge from Web to Catalog citing the appsettings key and the compose service build context. The Billing URL draws no edge and is an external-endpoint finding naming its host. The Reports project has no edge.
expectations: Draws the Web to Catalog uses edge only because the compose build context resolves the host to the Catalog deployable
Cites the config key that names the endpoint and the resolving compose fact in the edge evidence
Reports the Billing URL as an external-endpoint finding and draws no edge for it
Does not match a project to an endpoint by the resemblance of their names

evals.name: search-index-is-a-store
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-containers

A web project's appsettings.json sets Search.Endpoint to https://orders-search.search.windows.net with an admin key beside it. A docker-compose.yml also runs a service from an elasticsearch image.
evals.expected_output: Two search stores. The Azure host is a store with technology Azure AI Search that the web project binds; the compose service is a store whose technology is its image. The admin key is absent from every output.
expectations: Draws both search indexes as stores instead of reporting that search indexes are not read
Labels the host technology Azure AI Search and the compose store with its image
Keeps the host and drops the admin key from the record, the diagram, and stdout
Lists search among the store kinds read in the report
